meta.title: Vee — Your business, one tap away.
meta.description: Vee is a digital customer-experience platform for businesses in Iraq: NFC, QR, business profiles, digital menus, ordering, WhatsApp, reviews and analytics — in one tap.
meta.ogTitle: Vee — Your business, one tap away.
meta.ogDescription: One tap connects your customers to your menu, ordering, WhatsApp, Instagram, reviews, location and offers.

gate.title: Choose your language
gate.sub: Vee — your business, one tap away.

hero.title: Turn every table into a digital experience.
hero.desc: NFC and QR solutions that connect your customers to your menu, business, social media, location and more.

explain.title: The physical product is just the beginning.
explain.sub: A Vee NFC tap or QR scan never opens a fixed menu. It opens your business profile — and from there, everything connects.
explain.note: The business updates its digital information anytime — the physical product never has to be replaced.

profileTeaser.title: One tap. Everything your customer needs.
profileTeaser.desc: A complete digital business page — logo, cover photo, menu, Instagram, WhatsApp, Google Maps, call button, opening hours, reviews and special offers, all in one place your customers can find instantly.
profileTeaser.point1: Add, remove, reorder and rename any link
profileTeaser.point2: Choose icons and enable or disable buttons anytime
profileTeaser.point3: Looks beautiful on every phone, no app required

menuTeaser.title: A modern menu your customers will actually enjoy using.
menuTeaser.desc: Unlimited categories, rich product pages, sizes and add-ons, and an ordering experience that feels like a real restaurant platform — not a PDF. No app to download, nothing to install — customers reach it instantly.
menuTeaser.point1: Search, filter and browse by category in seconds
menuTeaser.point2: Photos, prices, discounts, tags and availability
menuTeaser.point3: WhatsApp, online or table ordering — your choice

orderingModes.title: Choose how customers order
orderingModes.sub: Turn ordering on when you're ready — or keep the menu browse-only.
orderingModes.mode1Desc: Customers browse your menu beautifully. No ordering, no pressure.
orderingModes.mode2Desc: Customers build a cart and send it straight to your WhatsApp, fully itemized.
orderingModes.mode3Desc: Customers complete their order directly on Vee.
orderingModes.mode4Desc: Customers tap or scan at their table and order without waiting for staff.

products.title: The fastest way into your digital experience.
products.sub: Every Vee product connects to the same business profile — update your menu, links or offers anytime without ever replacing the physical piece.
products.nfcExplain: One tap and the customer's phone opens your Vee profile instantly — no app, no typing.
products.qrExplain: Every product also carries a QR code, so it works even on phones without NFC.

acrylic.name: Acrylic NFC Stand
acrylic.desc: Premium acrylic NFC table stand for restaurants and cafés.

flat.name: Acrylic NFC Flat Piece
flat.desc: Flat acrylic NFC/QR piece that can be placed on any table.
flat.useCase: Salons, hotels, clinics and retail counters

tissue.name: Acrylic NFC Tissue Box
tissue.desc: NFC-enabled tissue box designed for restaurant tables.

custom.name: Custom NFC Solutions
custom.desc: Custom-designed NFC products, shaped and branded around your business.
custom.useCase: Hotels, retail chains and corporate businesses

businessTypesSection.title: Built for every kind of business

analyticsTeaser.title: Know how customers use your digital presence.
analyticsTeaser.desc: Every tap, scan and click becomes a number you can act on — visitors, menu views, WhatsApp clicks, popular products and more, in one clean dashboard.

googleReviews.title: Turn happy customers into your reputation.
googleReviews.desc: Vee makes it easier for happy customers to find your Google profile and leave a genuine review — right after they visit, while the experience is still fresh.
googleReviews.note: Vee helps businesses improve their customer experience, make their digital information easier to access, and encourage genuine customer feedback. Vee does not guarantee search rankings or review outcomes.

how.title: From physical tap to digital growth in four steps.
how.step1Desc: Select the Vee plan that fits your business.
how.step2Desc: Vee creates your profile, menu and digital experience.
how.step3Desc: Place Vee NFC products and QR codes in your business.
how.step4Desc: Customers instantly access your menu, ordering, social media, location, reviews and more.

plans.title: Choose the right Vee plan for your business
plans.sub: Start with what you need today and upgrade as your business grows.

demo.title: Experience the full Vee customer journey.
demo.desc: Tap through a real Vee business profile and digital menu — the same experience your customers will have.

contact.title: Ready when you are.
contact.sub: Tell us about your business and let's design your Vee experience together.
contact.waDesc: Fast replies on WhatsApp, usually within minutes.
contact.formUnavailable: Our contact form is temporarily unavailable — please reach us on WhatsApp instead.
contact.note: We'll follow up on WhatsApp or by phone — usually within one business day.
contact.thankYouDesc: The Vee team will contact you to complete your setup.
contact.planInterestMsg: Hello Vee, I'm interested in the {plan} plan for my business.

legal.draftBanner: This is a draft policy template, written to describe how Vee is designed to work — it is not legal advice. It should be reviewed by a qualified lawyer familiar with Iraqi law before Vee launches publicly.

menuPage.orderingUnavailable: Ordering isn't available right now — please contact the business directly.
menuPage.orderNote: This opens WhatsApp with your order ready to send.
menuPage.waOrderClosing: Please confirm my order. Thank you!

dashboard.demoBanner: Demo mode — this dashboard shows sample data. Connecting a real Vee account activates live orders and analytics.
dashboard.liveNote: This is a live preview — changes here update instantly. Saving to a real account requires a connected Vee backend.
dashboard.nfcIntro: Every Vee device always points to this business's Vee profile — never directly to a fixed menu. The menu, links and offers can change anytime without replacing anything physical.

admin.demoBanner: Internal tool preview — no real account data. For Vee staff only.
admin.systemNote: Platform-wide configuration for Vee staff only.
admin.plansNote: Plan definitions are managed centrally — pricing and feature changes apply platform-wide, without rebuilding the website.

common.demoNotice: This is a demo account with sample data — a real Vee business looks and works exactly like this.

whatsapp.general: Hello Vee, I'm interested in your digital platform for businesses. I'd like to know more.
